description: Validates opt-in receipt-capture declarations against published protobuf contracts and the reconciled global policy snapshot.

levels.name: Capture contract invalid
levels.description: A declared capture source is invalid or unreconciled.

levels.name: Capture declaration validated
levels.description: Declared policies match the global policy snapshot.

levels.name: Capture conformance clean
levels.description: The declared capture contract is continuously verified.
exit_criteria: Every declared policy has emitted a durable receipt.

levels.name: Capture proven
levels.description: Every declared policy has durable emission evidence.
entry_criteria: Every declared policy emitted a receipt.

capabilities.label: Declared Receipt Capture
capabilities.description: Consumer-authored receipt declarations are descriptor-valid and reconciled into the global snapshot.

levels.name: Invalid
levels.description: The capture declaration cannot be trusted.
levels.capability_summary: Receipt capture is not safely configured.
levels.next_unlock: Repair the declaration or reconcile the policies.

levels.name: Validated
levels.description: The declaration is valid and reconciled.

levels.name: Conformant
levels.description: The capture declaration remains clean under the provider phase.
levels.next_unlock: Exercise every policy and retain its receipt evidence.

levels.name: Proven
levels.description: Every declared policy has durable emission evidence.
levels.capability_summary: Every declared receipt policy has durable emission evidence.

event_capture.declaration_invalid.reason: A capture declaration must be schema and descriptor valid before it can observe a response.

event_capture.literal_instance_identifie.reason: A literal instance identifier makes a reusable capture declaration non-scalable.

event_capture.policy_unreconciled.reason: A valid declaration that is absent from the global snapshot observes nothing.

event_capture.policy_unexercised.reason: A reconciled policy without a receipt cannot prove cross-scenario capture.
